mathematical_review.analytic_derivative: Product rule for s(gx)*(ux) yields s_second(gx)*(ux)*g*gT + s_first(gx)*(g*uT+u*gT), summed over down coefficients. Axis order[probe,output,input,input] and finite difference assignment reviewed.
mathematical_review.richardson: Stencil has O(h^2) leading truncation for both mixed terms and diagonal effective2h; (4H(h)-H(2h))/3 cancels it for smooth functions.
mathematical_review.packing: sqrt2 uppertriangle packing preserves symmetric Frobenius inner product; independent norm control passed.
mathematical_review.subspace_metric: RMS of principal-angle sines is ||V-V E^T E||F/sqrt(rank); independent knownangle.3 control matched0.17061867086689825.
mathematical_review.channels: Returned FP32/FP16 round only FP64 outputs. fp32_compute casts inputs/weights and performs NumPy array arithmetic inFP32, then returns FP64 for subtraction. Independent tiny probe confirms compute channel differs from output-only FP32 rounding.

limits: FP32 analytic reference is a smooth FP64-arithmetic model using FP32-rounded stored weights at continuous input points; it is not a classical derivative of the piecewise-rounded runtime map. Runtime error includes input and intermediate arithmetic rounding.
NumPy FP32 is not hardware BF16/TF32 and output-only FP16 is not FP16 model execution.
Richardson cancellation assumes smooth truncation; it may amplify rounding noise.
No estimator spectral-gap acceptance threshold: degradation is the subject of the diagnostic, not a failure to hide.
